description: Read recent change events for your watches (all, or one `watch_id`): verdict before and after, a compact change summary, the event receipt and whether the webhook delivery succeeded. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

continuity_handle.description: The continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; proves you own these watches.

name: gaip_watch_events
title: Read watch change events
